dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Bzt! ♪ The open sky. The fresh air. The Pokémon. <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>It has
been a time since I saw them all.

<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Hello. Hello. Will you be a friend of mine? <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,10)>Let us
talk together.

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Hello. Hello. There was a big building above here. Why is
it gone?
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>It flew to the sky? It is difficult to believe.

<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)>Incredible. Those humans were making a thing of
amazement. <$voicel(1,8)>I now understand.

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>There were many humans. They looked “sketchy.” They
did things around the building.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,3)>One day, they disappeared. I went inside to investigate.
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,8)>But I was unable to exit.

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I could not exit and had no things to do, so I slept. How
long did I sleep? I do not know. <$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>When I woke, I was here.
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,7)>When the building flew, maybe I fell out.

<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,4)>The building was a comfortable space for sleeping.
It would have been a good home. <$emotion(1,31)><$voicel(1,2)>This is unfortunate.

<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>You can make a home that is like the building. Is it
a possibility?

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>If so, I would like that a large amount. Something like this.
Please make it.
<$emotion(1,50)><$voicel(1,8)>I count on you.
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>I wish for you to make my home.
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>You did it. You made my home. I thank you.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I wish to repay you. What can I do. I must think.

<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh. <$cdef(27)>. I have an idea. Do you
have
interest
in
<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(13)>?
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>It will let you float around. This is very fun. You must try.
<$emotion(1,37)><$voicel(1,9)>Wow. <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>. Your floating is skillful.

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>You must continue to practice. You will master
<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(13)>.
